arguments.sql: SELECT ml.state AS state, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE LENGTH(ml.state) = 2 AND ml.state <> '' AND ml.state = UPPER(ml.state) GROUP BY ml.state ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, ml.state ASC LIMIT 5
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions by the US state of their merchant location and lists the five highest, largest first.
assumptions: Counts all transactions, labelled or not, since the question asks about transactions rather than fraud.
US states are taken as two-letter uppercase codes in merchant_locations.state; country names and the empty state of online locations are excluded.
Ties are broken alphabetically by state code.
